title: Guardrail Policy
description: The model AS an enforcement layer (Core Model §04). Data, not code: a versioned object a process owner edits without a deploy, that a generic Enforcement Point reads to allow / escalate / deny an agent action before it executes. Every edit is a new version; every logged agent action cites the version it acted under, so a later dispute resolves against the policy that actually applied. LOCKED for Phase 1.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. gr.CO.3.2.7. The version is a separate field; the agent-facing ref pins both (e.g. gr.CO.3.2.7.v3).

attaches_to.description: Where this policy hangs. process = inherited by all tasks beneath; task = an explicit override.

ref.description: apqc_code for a process, or full task id for a task.

allowed_actions.description: Explicit allow-list of action types the agent may take unattended within this step. Everything not listed is implicitly denied; forbidden_actions makes specific exclusions auditable.

forbidden_actions.description: Explicit deny-list — kept separate from 'everything not allowed' so an audit shows what was deliberately excluded, not just omitted.

escalate_if.description: Boolean condition expression over scoped fields (risk score, transaction size, tier, confidence) that routes to a human instead of auto-executing. null = never escalate on condition. Grammar in guardrail-template/DEFAULT-GUARDRAIL-TEMPLATE.md.

data_scope.description: Exact fields/records the agent may read or write — least privilege by default, never 'the whole customer record'.

rate_limit.description: Bound on action frequency per agent per window — contains a looping/misbehaving agent automatically. null = inherit tenant default.

escalation_path.description: Who gets the escalation — a ROLE, not a person, so coverage survives staff turnover.

audit_requirement.description: What must be logged for this action class. timestamp_outcome = lightest; full_capture = full input/output + reasoning for high-stakes actions.

version.description: Monotonic. Bumped on every edit. An in-flight agent session pins the version it read (§04 'why versioned, not just logged').

review.description: ISO 9001 §7.5 review/approval trail for this policy version.
